$comment: The facet vocabulary of Stock (data, not code): every facet the storefront shows, in order, with its values, synonyms and the rules that derive auto and draft (weak) labels from the specs. scripts/build-index.ts reads it; components render any facet listed here. draft: true marks facets whose labels are weak (not reviewed by a person). Rules: a value is given when any clause of `any` matches and no clause of `not` does; `fallback` is the value when no rule matched.
